property_summary: For any call, C.owner() must return the address stored at immutable-args offset 0x0, and this differs from the collateral address at offset 0x14; the mutant makes owner() return collateral() instead, so owner() == collateral() on the buggy contract while owner() != collateral() on the reference for essentially all calls.

For any sender and any token addresses, a Cooler cloned by the factory stores the generating sender as its immutable-args owner, so cooler.owner() must always equal that sender; the mutant reads offset 0x14 (collateral) instead, so for any sender != collateral token the buggy cooler returns the collateral address instead of the sender.

For any sender and any collateral/debt token pair, a cooler created by CoolerFactory has the generating sender encoded as the first immutable arg, so owner() must always return that sender (which differs from the collateral at offset 0x14 whenever sender != collateral); the mutant reads offset 0x14 so owner() returns the collateral token instead for any sender != collateral.

For any sender and token pair, a factory-generated cooler stores the generating sender as its immutable-args owner, so cooler.owner() must always return that sender; the mutant reads offset 0x14 (the collateral token) instead, so for any sender different from the collateral token address the buggy cooler returns the wrong owner.

For any caller and any collateral/debt token pair, a cooler generated through the CoolerFactory encodes the generating caller as its first immutable argument, so cooler.owner() must always return that caller; the mutant reads offset 0x14 (the collateral token) instead, so for any caller != collateral the buggy cooler's owner() differs from the generating caller.

For any cooler created by CoolerFactory.generateCooler on behalf of an actor, the clone's owner() must return that creating actor (immutable arg at offset 0x0); the mutant returns the debt token (offset 0x28) instead, so any actor != debt token breaks it.

For any calldata, owner() must return the top 20 bytes of the first 32-byte word; when the call begins with the 4-byte owner() selector (whose upper 20 bytes are zero), the reference always returns address(0), while the mutant reading offset 0x28 returns a caller-controlled nonzero address for some inputs.

For any actor, a cooler generated by the factory embeds that actor as the immutable arg at offset 0x0, so the clone's owner() must always return the generating actor; the mutant reads offset 0x28 (the debt token) instead, so it returns a different address whenever the debt token differs from the actor.

For any calldata whose two-byte trailer encodes the immutable-args length, C.owner() returns the 20 bytes at the trailer-derived offset (bytes 0..19), while the mutant reading offset 0x28 returns the zero bytes at bytes 40..59 instead.

For any calldata whose final two bytes encode a trailer of 32, C.owner() returns the top 20 bytes of the 32-byte word at byte offset 4 (the immutable-args region); the mutant reads the word at offset 0x2c, which lies past the end of the calldata and is therefore always zero, so it returns address(0) whenever the embedded top-20-bytes are nonzero.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(uint256): owner() must return embedded top-20-bytes

property_summary: For any Cooler created by CoolerFactory.generateCooler with immutable args (owner, collateral, debt, factory), C.owner() must return the owner passed at immutable-arg offset 0x0; the mutant reads offset 0x3c and wrongly returns the factory address instead, so owner() != the supplied owner for any owner that differs from the factory.

For any actor, the cooler created via CoolerFactory.generateCooler must report that actor as its owner (immutable arg at offset 0x0); the mutant reads offset 0x3c and returns the factory address instead, violating owner()==creator for every creator that is not the factory.

For any clone instantiated with immutable args (owner, collateral, debt, factory), C.owner() must return the address stored at immutable-arg offset 0x0 (the owner), which the mutant violates by reading offset 0x3c and returning the factory address instead.
